publication_biological_design.evolutionary_ancestry: source-inferred single origin and two losses of visible heteranthery; transition directions subject to source phylogeny
publication_biological_design.comparison_population: congeneric phylogeny plus focal C. cylindrica pollen fate and C. unguiculata dosing/visitor manipulations
publication_biological_design.sample_framework: mechanism-test study, not outcome-blind global species cohort

receipts.inference: near-conventional threshold only; association not experimental timing/origin
movement association within source phylogeny; not causal origin

receipts.endpoint: anther whorl pollen availability timing overlap
receipts.unit: six heterantherous vs five nonheterantherous greenhouse-grown source species
receipts.inference: source reports less temporal overlap in heterantherous species; not a genomic transition

receipts.endpoint: outer-anther pollen fraction on bee scopa vs floral stigma
receipts.unit: scopa/stigma observations from same Clarkia cylindrica study
receipts.inference: no detected destination contrast; does NOT demonstrate equivalence or absence of partial specialization

receipts.endpoint: outer-anther fraction vs sample total pollen
receipts.inference: reported positive correlation; dependency with fate observations

receipts.endpoint: outer-anther filament paint colour vs pollen-collecting visit fraction
receipts.inference: bee handling depends on colour, but no independent structure origin

receipts.endpoint: exposed pollen along C. unguiculata outer anthers
receipts.unit: 20 flowers per treatment; source greenhouse trial
receipts.inference: more exposed pollen under fully dehisced/no-dosing treatment; distinct from exported pollen

receipts.endpoint: stigma pollen deposition after foraging bouts; no-dosing relative to dosing
receipts.unit: 13 dosing vs 15 no-dosing arrays, one bumblebee per array
receipts.inference: no statistically detected transport improvement for dosing; log coefficient negative for no-dosing, not proof of benefit/equivalence

receipts.endpoint: bee corbicular pollen mass after foraging bouts
receipts.unit: same 13 vs 15 greenhouse arrays (one bee per array)
receipts.inference: no detected difference in mass, not strict equivalence

receipts.endpoint: bee visitation after outer-whorl removal at different flower times
receipts.unit: same C. unguiculata plant/visitor field programme
receipts.inference: outer whorl visitor function can change with flower age; exact effect SE not in current paper receipt
